blocks.zh: 生物藥品製造完整教學版｜範圍、Table 1、Part A 通則、Part B 特定產品類型
blocks.en: Annex 2B Complete Teaching Edition | Scope, Table 1, Part A General Requirements, Part B Specific Product Types

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Annex 2B 的適用範圍與 Table 1 中七大產品類型的 GMP 適用邏輯，能判斷哪些步驟需要完整 GMP vs. 僅需 GMP 原則
blocks.en: Understand the scope of Annex 2B and the GMP logic behind the seven product types in Table 1, and be able to judge which steps need full GMP and which need only GMP principles

blocks.zh: 掌握 Part A 通則：人員、廠房設備、動物管理、文件、生產、種子批次與細胞庫系統的核心要求
blocks.en: Master the core Part A requirements: personnel, premises and equipment, animal handling, documentation, production, and the seed lot and cell bank system

blocks.zh: 了解 Part B 針對疫苗、免疫血清、重組產品、單株抗體、過敏原及基因轉殖動植物產品的特定指引
blocks.en: Understand the specific Part B guidance for vaccines, immune sera, recombinant products, monoclonal antibodies, allergens, and transgenic animal and plant products

blocks.zh: 將 CDMO 台灣廠的生物製程決策（發酵早期步驟、MCB/WCB 建立、多產品廠設計）對應到 Annex 2B 具體條文要求
blocks.en: Map the biological process decisions of a Taiwan CDMO site (early fermentation steps, MCB/WCB establishment, multi-product facility design) to specific Annex 2B requirements

blocks.zh: SCOPE — 適用範圍
blocks.en: SCOPE

blocks.zh: 範圍解析
blocks.en: Scope Explained

blocks.zh: Annex 2B vs. 2A — 兩者分工
blocks.en: Annex 2B vs. 2A: How the Work Is Divided

blocks.zh: Annex 2A：ATMP（先進治療醫療產品）— 基因療法、細胞療法、組織工程
blocks.en: Annex 2A: ATMPs (advanced therapy medicinal products) - gene therapy, cell therapy, tissue-engineered products

blocks.zh: Annex 2B：所有其他生物製品 — 疫苗、單株抗體、重組蛋白、免疫血清、過敏原等
blocks.en: Annex 2B: all other biological products - vaccines, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, immune sera, allergens, etc.

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 若承接 CAR-T 或基因療法委託，需適用 Annex 2A；承接傳統疫苗或 mAb 則適用本 Annex 2B。
blocks.en: A Taiwan CDMO taking on CAR-T or gene therapy contracts must apply Annex 2A; conventional vaccines or mAbs fall under this Annex 2B.

blocks.zh: 比喻：GMP 是一條漸進的坡道
blocks.en: Analogy: GMP Is a Gradual Ramp

blocks.zh: 生物製程的早期步驟（如初始發酵培養）就像在坡道底部——GMP 原則要遵守，但細節要求較寬鬆，且主管機關通常不會主動查廠。
blocks.en: Early steps of a biological process (such as initial fermentation culture) sit at the bottom of the ramp: GMP principles must be followed, but the detailed requirements are looser, and the regulator does not usually inspect them proactively.

blocks.zh: 越靠近最終滅菌前的步驟，坡道越陡——環境管制、文件要求、測試頻率全面升高，對應到 Part I 的要求。
blocks.en: The closer a step is to final sterilisation, the steeper the ramp becomes: environmental control, documentation requirements and testing frequency all rise, corresponding to the Part I requirements.

blocks.zh: 重要分界：滅菌前後
blocks.en: The Key Dividing Line: Before vs. After Sterilisation

blocks.zh: 滅菌前的生物活性物質製造：主要參考 Part II（API GMP）
blocks.en: Manufacture of the biological active substance before sterilisation: mainly refer to Part II (API GMP)

blocks.zh: 滅菌後的後續步驟：適用 Part I（製劑 GMP）
blocks.en: Steps after sterilisation: Part I (finished product GMP) applies

blocks.zh: 這個分界點在 CDMO 廠的廠房設計和系統建置上非常重要——需要清楚定義在哪個步驟之後，文件、環控、人員訓練要全面切換到更高標準。
blocks.en: This dividing line is critical for CDMO facility design and system build: you need to define clearly after which step documentation, environmental control and personnel training switch fully to the higher standard.

blocks.zh: 基因改造生物體（GMO）的額外法規層
blocks.en: An Additional Regulatory Layer for Genetically Modified Organisms (GMOs)

blocks.zh: 在台灣生物製程廠製造重組蛋白或基因工程疫苗時，除了 GMP 要求，還需符合生物安全等級（Biosafety Level）的規定，兩者不得衝突。
blocks.en: When a Taiwan biologics site manufactures recombinant proteins or genetically engineered vaccines, it must comply with biosafety level requirements in addition to GMP, and the two must not conflict.

blocks.zh: 建立 GMO 設施時需同時評估：GMP 潔淨等級要求 vs. 生物安全封鎖需求，找到兩者都符合的設計方案。
blocks.en: When establishing a GMO facility, evaluate GMP cleanliness grade requirements against biosafety containment needs, and find a design that satisfies both.

blocks.zh: Table 1 — 製造活動範圍說明表
blocks.en: Table 1: Scope of Manufacturing Activities

blocks.zh: Table 1 解讀與 CDMO 實務
blocks.en: Reading Table 1 and CDMO Practice

blocks.zh: Table 1 的核心邏輯
blocks.en: The Core Logic of Table 1

blocks.zh: 這張表用顏色（灰色）標示哪些步驟落在 Annex 2B 範疇內。核心原則：越靠近最終產品，GMP 要求越嚴格。
blocks.en: The table uses shading (grey) to mark which steps fall within the scope of Annex 2B. The core principle: the closer a step is to the final product, the stricter the GMP requirements.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這張表幫助你判斷：哪個步驟要開始適用完整的批次紀錄、偏差管理、環境監控系統。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this table helps you decide from which step full batch records, deviation management and environmental monitoring systems must apply.

blocks.zh: 關鍵縮寫對照
blocks.en: Key Abbreviations

blocks.zh:
MCB  = Master Cell Bank（主細胞庫）
WCB  = Working Cell Bank（工作細胞庫）
MVS  = Master Virus Seed（主毒種批次）
WVS  = Working Virus Seed（工作毒種批次）
MSL  = Master Seed Lot（主種子批次）
WSL  = Working Seed Lot（工作種子批次）
MAb  = Monoclonal Antibody（單株抗體）
blocks.en:
MCB  = Master Cell Bank
WCB  = Working Cell Bank
MVS  = Master Virus Seed
WVS  = Working Virus Seed
MSL  = Master Seed Lot
WSL  = Working Seed Lot
MAb  = Monoclonal Antibody

blocks.zh: 比喻：MCB/WCB 是「生物原料的原始股」
blocks.en: Analogy: MCB/WCB Are the "Founding Shares" of Biological Raw Material

blocks.zh: MCB 就像公司的創始股東名冊——只有一份、保存在特殊條件下、不輕易動用。
blocks.en: The MCB is like a company's founding shareholder register: there is only one, it is kept under special conditions, and it is not drawn on lightly.

blocks.zh: WCB 是從 MCB 衍生出來用於日常生產的工作版本，就像日常運作用的流通股。
blocks.en: The WCB is the working version derived from the MCB for routine production, like the shares in everyday circulation.

blocks.zh: MCB 若出問題，整條產品線就得停擺；WCB 出問題，至少還有 MCB 可以重新建立 WCB。
blocks.en: If the MCB fails, the whole product line stops; if a WCB fails, you can at least re-establish a WCB from the MCB.

blocks.zh: CDMO 決策練習：我的製程是哪一行？
blocks.en: CDMO Decision Exercise: Which Row Is My Process?

blocks.zh: 情境：台灣 CDMO 承接客戶委託，生產重組 EPO（促紅血球生成素）。
blocks.en: Scenario: a Taiwan CDMO takes on a client contract to produce recombinant EPO (erythropoietin).

blocks.zh: 產品類型：第 3 類（生物技術發酵／細胞培養）
blocks.en: Product type: Category 3 (biotechnology fermentation / cell culture)

blocks.zh: MCB/WCB 建立需在完整 GMP 條件下進行
blocks.en: MCB/WCB establishment must be performed under full GMP conditions

blocks.zh: CHO 細胞培養階段：GMP 適用，需完整批次紀錄
blocks.en: CHO cell culture stage: GMP applies, with full batch records

blocks.zh: 蛋白質純化與修飾：高度管制，需驗證的製程
blocks.en: Protein purification and modification: tightly controlled, with a validated process

blocks.zh: 製劑灌裝：Part I 完整要求，無菌管制
blocks.en: Fill-finish: full Part I requirements, with aseptic control

blocks.zh: 早期步驟「不列入常規查廠」的含義
blocks.en: What "Early Steps Are Not Routinely Inspected" Means

blocks.zh: Annex 2B 明確指出：早期步驟納入範疇，不代表主管機關會例行查廠這些步驟。
blocks.en: Annex 2B states explicitly that inclusion of early steps in the scope does not mean that the regulator will routinely inspect those steps.

blocks.zh: 實務意義：即使早期發酵步驟在理論上受 Annex 2B 規範，稽查員通常聚焦在後端純化、填充和放行測試。但文件必須齊全，以備不時之需。
blocks.en: Practical meaning: even though early fermentation steps are in theory covered by Annex 2B, inspectors usually focus on downstream purification, filling and release testing. Documentation must nevertheless be complete, in case it is needed.

blocks.zh: PRINCIPLE — 製造原則
blocks.en: PRINCIPLE

blocks.zh: 製造原則解析
blocks.en: The Manufacturing Principle Explained

blocks.zh: 為什麼生物製品比化學藥品「難管」？
blocks.en: Why Are Biological Products Harder to Control Than Chemical Drugs?

blocks.zh: 化學藥品：合成反應遵循固定的化學方程式，批次間變異相對小，物化分析方法精確。
blocks.en: Chemical drugs: synthesis follows fixed chemical equations, batch-to-batch variation is relatively small, and physicochemical analytical methods are precise.

blocks.zh: 生物製品：活細胞本身就有自然變異，培養條件的微小差異（pH、溶氧、溫度）都可能影響蛋白質折疊、糖基化模式，導致批次間產品特性差異。
blocks.en: Biological products: living cells carry natural variability, and small differences in culture conditions (pH, dissolved oxygen, temperature) can affect protein folding and glycosylation patterns, leading to batch-to-batch differences in product characteristics.

blocks.zh: 比喻：生物製程是「養活生物」不是「燒化學品」
blocks.en: Analogy: Biological Processing Is Keeping Organisms Alive, Not Cooking Chemicals

blocks.zh: 化學合成就像按照食譜煮菜——原料加對、溫度控制好，成品基本一致。
blocks.en: Chemical synthesis is like following a recipe: add the right ingredients, control the temperature, and the result is basically the same each time.

blocks.zh: 細胞培養更像養一群挑剔的生物——環境稍有不對勁，它們就產生不一樣的代謝產物。這就是為什麼 QRM 在生物製程中特別重要：你需要主動識別、評估每個變異來源的風險。
blocks.en: Cell culture is more like keeping a group of fussy organisms: if the environment is slightly off, they produce different metabolites. This is why QRM is especially important in biological processes: you must proactively identify and assess the risk of every source of variation.

blocks.zh: 生物製程的汙染雙重挑戰
blocks.en: The Double Contamination Challenge in Biological Processes

blocks.zh: 挑戰一：培養基設計為促進目標細胞生長，同樣也為雜菌提供了溫床
blocks.en: Challenge 1: culture media are designed to promote growth of the target cells, and they equally provide a breeding ground for adventitious microorganisms

blocks.zh: 挑戰二：部分產品無法承受強力去除病毒的純化步驟（如高溫、極端 pH），因此防護設計在前端更加重要
blocks.en: Challenge 2: some products cannot withstand purification steps that strongly remove or inactivate viruses (such as high heat or extreme pH), so protective design at the front end is even more important

blocks.zh: CDMO 對應策略：密閉系統設計 + 嚴格的環境監控 + 驗證的病毒去除步驟（如過濾、色層分析）。
blocks.en: CDMO response strategy: closed system design + strict environmental monitoring + validated virus removal steps (such as filtration and chromatography).

blocks.zh: In-Process Control 的特殊地位
blocks.en: The Special Status of In-Process Control

blocks.zh: 化學藥品可以等最終產品出來再做一次全面測試；但生物製品的中間品往往無法長期保存，且某些產品的最終放行測試本身耗時長（如細菌培養）。
blocks.en: A chemical drug can wait until the final product is available and then be fully tested; but biological intermediates often cannot be stored for long, and the final release tests for some products take a long time in themselves (such as bacterial culture).

blocks.zh: 因此，在製程中每個關鍵步驟取樣測試（IPC），是確保生物藥品品質的核心手段，而非補救措施。
blocks.en: Sampling and testing at each critical step during the process (IPC) is therefore a core means of ensuring the quality of biological medicines, not a remedial measure.

blocks.zh: TSE 風險管控
blocks.en: TSE Risk Control

blocks.zh: 使用動物源性原料（牛血清、胰蛋白酶等）時，需評估 TSE（海綿狀腦病，如狂牛病）傳播風險。
blocks.en: When animal-derived materials (bovine serum, trypsin, etc.) are used, the risk of TSE (transmissible spongiform encephalopathy, such as BSE) transmission must be assessed.

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 採購這類原料時，需要供應商的 TSE 合規文件，並優先選用非動物源或重組來源替代品。
blocks.en: When a Taiwan CDMO buys such materials, it needs the supplier's TSE compliance documents, and should give priority to non-animal-derived or recombinant alternatives.

blocks.zh: Part A — 人員與廠房設備
blocks.en: Part A: Personnel and Premises & Equipment

blocks.zh: 人員與廠房解析
blocks.en: Personnel and Premises Explained

blocks.zh: 生物製程人員訓練的三個特殊面向
blocks.en: Three Special Aspects of Training for Biological Process Personnel

blocks.zh: 產品特異性訓練：製造 BCG 疫苗的人員，需了解結核菌的感染風險與防護措施，與製造一般重組蛋白的人員訓練內容完全不同
blocks.en: Product-specific training: staff making BCG vaccine need to understand the infection risk of tubercle bacilli and the protective measures, which is entirely different from the training of staff making ordinary recombinant proteins

blocks.zh: 健康監控：如有免疫系統疾病或近期接受免疫抑制治療的員工，不能進入某些高風險區域
blocks.en: Health monitoring: employees with immune system disorders or recent immunosuppressive treatment must not enter certain high-risk areas

blocks.zh: 動線管制：從活菌區走到滅活產品區，即使是維修人員也必須有明確的換裝或清潔程序
blocks.en: Movement control: moving from a live-organism area to an inactivated-product area requires a clear changing or cleaning procedure, even for maintenance staff

blocks.zh: 比喻：多產品廠就像共用廚房
blocks.en: Analogy: A Multi-Product Facility Is Like a Shared Kitchen

blocks.zh: 在同一廚房做海鮮和做花生製品，都需要：嚴格的清潔驗證（證明沒有殘留），分開的器具或有序的使用時間（campaign 製造），以及清楚的標示和隔離。
blocks.en: Making seafood dishes and peanut products in the same kitchen requires strict cleaning validation (proving there is no residue), separate utensils or orderly scheduling (campaign manufacture), and clear labelling and segregation.

blocks.zh: 生物製程的挑戰更大：活菌可能形成孢子、病毒可能在環境中存活——清潔驗證必須針對具體的微生物特性進行。
blocks.en: The challenge is greater in biological processing: live bacteria can form spores and viruses can survive in the environment, so cleaning validation must address the specific microbial characteristics.

blocks.zh: 正壓 vs. 負壓的設計邏輯
blocks.en: The Design Logic of Positive vs. Negative Pressure

blocks.zh: 正壓區（保護產品）：無菌填充區、關鍵製造區 → 防止外部汙染進入
blocks.en: Positive-pressure areas (protect the product): aseptic filling areas, critical manufacturing areas → prevent outside contamination from entering

blocks.zh: 負壓區（保護人員和環境）：病原體操作區 → 防止危險微生物外洩
blocks.en: Negative-pressure areas (protect people and the environment): pathogen handling areas → prevent hazardous microorganisms from escaping

blocks.zh: CDMO 廠若同時有「無菌製造」和「病原體操作」需求，廠房設計必須仔細規劃壓差梯度，確保兩個目標都能達成且不衝突。
blocks.en: If a CDMO site needs both "aseptic manufacture" and "pathogen handling", the pressure cascade must be planned carefully so that both objectives are met without conflict.

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 在發酵設備的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of CIP/SIP for Fermentation Equipment

blocks.zh: CIP（就地清洗）：不拆管路，用清洗液循環清洗，驗證清洗效果（TOC、生物負載）
blocks.en: CIP (clean-in-place): circulate cleaning solution without dismantling the pipework, and verify cleaning effectiveness (TOC, bioburden)

blocks.zh: SIP（就地蒸氣滅菌）：發酵槽閥門需能承受蒸氣滅菌，確保滅菌後的密封性
blocks.en: SIP (steam-in-place): fermenter valves must withstand steam sterilisation and keep their seal integrity afterwards

blocks.zh: 空氣過濾器（疏水性 PTFE 材質）需定期做完整性測試（泡點或壓力持留測試），防止因過濾器失效導致整批發酵汙染。
blocks.en: Air filters (hydrophobic PTFE) need regular integrity testing (bubble point or pressure hold test), to prevent filter failure from contaminating a whole fermentation batch.

blocks.zh: 多產品廠的 QRM 決策框架
blocks.en: QRM Decision Framework for Multi-Product Facilities

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 評估是否接受新產品（如在現有 mAb 廠添加腺病毒載體疫苗）時，需評估：
blocks.en: When a Taiwan CDMO evaluates whether to accept a new product (for example, adding an adenovirus vector vaccine to an existing mAb facility), it should assess:

blocks.zh: 病毒的致病性等級（Biosafety Level）
blocks.en: The pathogenicity level of the virus (Biosafety Level)

blocks.zh: 現有清潔方法對腺病毒的殺滅效果是否已驗證
blocks.en: Whether the existing cleaning method has been validated for inactivating adenovirus

blocks.zh: 是否需要獨立的 HVAC 系統
blocks.en: Whether a separate HVAC system is needed

blocks.zh: Campaign 安排與相鄰產品的交叉汙染風險
blocks.en: Cross-contamination risk from campaign scheduling and adjacent products

blocks.zh: 環境監控方法是否需要增加腺病毒特異性偵測
blocks.en: Whether environmental monitoring methods need to add adenovirus-specific detection

blocks.zh: Part A — 動物、文件與生產
blocks.en: Part A: Animals, Documentation and Production

blocks.zh: 動物、文件與生產解析
blocks.en: Animals, Documentation and Production Explained

blocks.zh: 動物作為原料的特殊風險管理
blocks.en: Special Risk Management for Animals as Raw Material

blocks.zh: 使用活體動物（馬、羊）生產免疫血清時，動物本身就是原料來源。Annex 2B 要求的「回溯程序（look-back）」確保：若某匹馬後來被確認患有某種疾病，之前採集的血清批次都能追溯到並評估風險。
blocks.en: When live animals (horses, sheep) are used to produce immune sera, the animal itself is the source of the raw material. The look-back procedure required by Annex 2B ensures that if a horse is later confirmed to have a disease, the serum batches collected earlier can all be traced and their risk assessed.

blocks.zh: SPF 動物（無特定病原體）需要符合藥典專論要求，標準更高——相當於「有出生證明的有機動物」。
blocks.en: SPF (specific pathogen free) animals must meet pharmacopoeial monograph requirements, a higher standard: the equivalent of "organic animals with a birth certificate".

blocks.zh: 人類組織供體：30 年追溯義務
blocks.en: Human Tissue Donors: 30-Year Traceability Obligation

blocks.zh: 這是生物製品中最嚴格的追溯要求之一。使用人類組織或細胞製造的生物製品，從供體到最終患者用藥的完整紀錄，必須保存至產品有效期後 30 年。
blocks.en: This is one of the strictest traceability requirements for biological products. For a biological product made from human tissue or cells, the complete record from donor to final patient administration must be kept for 30 years after the product's expiry.

blocks.zh: 實務上，CDMO 必須與客戶（MAH）明確在技術協議中規定：誰負責保管哪段追溯記錄，且如何在轉廠或公司易手時確保記錄不遺失。
blocks.en: In practice, the CDMO and the client (MAH) must state clearly in the technical agreement who keeps which part of the traceability records, and how records will not be lost when a site is transferred or a company changes hands.

blocks.zh: 比喻：細胞製品的「批次」定義難題
blocks.en: Analogy: The Difficulty of Defining a "Batch" for Cell Products

blocks.zh: 一般固體製劑的「批次」很直觀——同一鍋混合的片劑。
blocks.en: The "batch" of a conventional solid dosage form is intuitive: tablets from the same blend.

blocks.zh: 但細胞製品呢？來自不同供體的細胞能混在一起算一批嗎？通常不行（尤其是異體細胞治療）——每個供體的細胞可能就是一個獨立的「批次」。
blocks.en: But what about cell products? Can cells from different donors be pooled into one batch? Usually not (especially for allogeneic cell therapy): the cells of each donor may each constitute a separate "batch".

blocks.zh: Annex 2B 要求事先定義清楚，而不是等查廠時才解釋。
blocks.en: Annex 2B requires this to be defined in advance, rather than explained for the first time during an inspection.

blocks.zh: 控制策略涵蓋內毒素和生物負載
blocks.en: The Control Strategy Covers Endotoxin and Bioburden

blocks.zh: 培養基（溫暖、富含養分）特別容易孳生細菌並釋放內毒素（LPS）。即使細菌被後續步驟殺死，內毒素仍可能殘留在產品中，引發患者的發熱反應。
blocks.en: Culture media (warm and nutrient-rich) readily support bacterial growth and the release of endotoxin (LPS). Even if the bacteria are killed by later steps, endotoxin can remain in the product and cause febrile reactions in patients.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的控制策略需包含：培養基除菌過濾、原料內毒素限度測試、製程中定期的生物負載監控，以及最終產品的內毒素測試。
blocks.en: A CDMO's control strategy should include: sterile filtration of media, endotoxin limit testing of raw materials, regular in-process bioburden monitoring, and endotoxin testing of the final product.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：小批次細胞產品的交叉汙染防護
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Preventing Cross-Contamination for Small-Batch Cell Products

blocks.zh: 承接多個病患的同種異體細胞製品時，同一天可能有多個供體來源的細胞同時在廠內處理。需要的措施：
blocks.en: When handling allogeneic cell products for multiple patients, cells from several donors may be processed in the facility on the same day. Measures needed:

blocks.zh: 嚴格的隔離操作（不同隔離器或生物安全操作台）
blocks.en: Strict segregated operations (separate isolators or biosafety cabinets)

blocks.zh: 清晰的標示和確認程序（兩人確認制）
blocks.en: Clear labelling and verification procedures (two-person verification)

blocks.zh: 不同供體的細胞在不同時間段操作（時間隔離）
blocks.en: Cells from different donors handled at different times (segregation in time)

blocks.zh: 每個供體批次的完整鏈追溯記錄
blocks.en: Complete chain-of-identity traceability records for each donor batch

blocks.zh: Part A — 起始原料與原材料
blocks.en: Part A: Starting Materials and Raw Materials

blocks.zh: 起始原料解析
blocks.en: Starting Materials Explained

blocks.zh: 「先用後驗」（Use Before Test）的 QRM 評估
blocks.en: QRM Assessment for "Use Before Test"

blocks.zh: 某些測試（如無菌測試需 14 天）的等待時間，若等待結果才投料，會大幅延誤生產。Annex 2B 允許在測試結果尚未出來時先投入生產，但：
blocks.en: For some tests (such as the 14-day sterility test), waiting for results before using the material would greatly delay production. Annex 2B allows production to start before the test results are available, but:

blocks.zh: 必須事先以 QRM 評估風險（若測試失敗，影響哪些批次？）
blocks.en: The risk must first be assessed through QRM (if the test fails, which batches are affected?)

blocks.zh: 最終放行以測試結果為條件（conditional release）
blocks.en: Final release is conditional on the test results (conditional release)

blocks.zh: 必須有隔離和追溯機制，確保不合格原料的批次能被完整拉回
blocks.en: Quarantine and traceability mechanisms must be in place so that batches made with non-conforming material can be fully recalled

blocks.zh: 無法最終滅菌產品的原料管制加倍嚴格
blocks.en: Raw Material Control Is Doubly Strict for Products That Cannot Be Terminally Sterilised

blocks.zh: 對於不能最終滅菌的生物製品（大多數蛋白質藥物、活菌疫苗），原料的品質就是最終產品安全性的第一道防線。
blocks.en: For biological products that cannot be terminally sterilised (most protein drugs, live bacterial vaccines), the quality of raw materials is the first line of defence for the safety of the final product.

blocks.zh: Annex 1（無菌製造）的原則同樣適用於緩衝液、培養基的配製，即使在發酵階段——這代表無菌過濾、環境監控、潔淨度要求都必須提前介入。
blocks.en: The principles of Annex 1 (sterile manufacture) apply equally to the preparation of buffers and media, even at the fermentation stage. This means sterile filtration, environmental monitoring and cleanliness requirements must come into play earlier.

blocks.zh: 比喻：抗生素使用是「最後手段」
blocks.en: Analogy: Antibiotic Use Is a "Last Resort"

blocks.zh: 在活組織採集過程中，有時難以完全避免細菌汙染，所以允許在早期步驟使用抗生素降低生物負載。
blocks.en: During collection of living tissue, bacterial contamination is sometimes hard to avoid completely, so antibiotics are permitted in early steps to reduce bioburden.

blocks.zh: 但抗生素必須在指定步驟「洗掉」——就像廚師可以用消毒劑清洗食材，但不能讓消毒劑殘留在端上桌的菜裡。若患者對青黴素過敏，殘留的抗生素可能引發嚴重反應。
blocks.en: But the antibiotics must be "washed out" at a defined step: a chef may wash ingredients with a disinfectant, but must not let it remain in the dish served at the table. If a patient is allergic to penicillin, residual antibiotic can trigger a serious reaction.

blocks.zh: 人類組織採集：三重責任分工
blocks.en: Human Tissue Procurement: Three-Way Division of Responsibility

blocks.zh: 組織庫（Tissue Establishment）：負責供體評估、採集、初步測試，Responsible Person 批准出貨
blocks.en: Tissue Establishment: responsible for donor evaluation, procurement and initial testing, with the Responsible Person approving shipment

blocks.zh: 製造商（CDMO）：接收後適用完整 GMP，繼續追溯記錄
blocks.en: Manufacturer (CDMO): full GMP applies on receipt, and traceability records continue

blocks.zh: 技術協議：明確界定每個環節的責任，包括出現問題時的通報義務
blocks.en: Technical agreement: clearly defines the responsibilities at each link, including the duty to notify when problems arise

blocks.zh: 若組織庫在出貨後才收到供體健康資訊（如後續確診感染），必須立即通知製造商評估影響。
blocks.en: If the tissue establishment receives donor health information after shipment (for example, a later confirmed infection), it must notify the manufacturer immediately so that the impact can be assessed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 供應鏈稽核重點
blocks.en: Key Points for CDMO Supply Chain Audits

blocks.zh: 承接人類組織製品委託時，對組織庫的稽核應涵蓋：
blocks.en: When taking on a human tissue product contract, the audit of the tissue establishment should cover:

blocks.zh: 主管機關批准文件（Tissue Establishment 認可）
blocks.en: Regulatory approval documents (Tissue Establishment accreditation)

blocks.zh: Responsible Person 的資格與職責
blocks.en: Qualifications and duties of the Responsible Person

blocks.zh: 供體篩選與測試的 SOP
blocks.en: SOPs for donor screening and testing

blocks.zh: 冷鏈運輸驗證記錄
blocks.en: Cold chain transport validation records

blocks.zh: 追溯系統的完整性（從供體到批號的連結）
blocks.en: Integrity of the traceability system (the link from donor to batch number)

blocks.zh: 不良反應通報程序
blocks.en: Adverse reaction reporting procedure

blocks.zh: Part A — 種子批次與細胞庫系統
blocks.en: Part A: Seed Lot and Cell Bank System

blocks.zh: 種子批次與細胞庫解析
blocks.en: Seed Lots and Cell Banks Explained

blocks.zh: 雙層庫存系統的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Design Logic of the Two-Tier Bank System

blocks.zh:
Master Cell Bank (MCB) / Master Seed Lot (MSL)
主細胞庫 / 主種子批次
完整 GMP 建立、最嚴格管制、不輕易動用
blocks.en:
Master Cell Bank (MCB) / Master Seed Lot (MSL)
Established under full GMP
Most tightly controlled, not drawn on lightly

blocks.zh: ↓ 衍生
blocks.en: ↓ Derived

blocks.zh:
Working Cell Bank (WCB) / Working Seed Lot (WSL)
工作細胞庫 / 工作種子批次
日常生產使用，可從 MCB 重新補充
blocks.en:
Working Cell Bank (WCB) / Working Seed Lot (WSL)
Used for routine production
Can be replenished from the MCB

blocks.zh: ↓ 培養至指定代數
blocks.en: ↓ Cultured to the specified passage level

blocks.zh:
Production Culture → 批次生產
代數需符合 CTA/MA 規格
blocks.en:
Production Culture → Batch production
Passage number must comply with CTA/MA specifications

blocks.zh: MCB 建立前 vs. 建立後：GMP 要求的分水嶺
blocks.en: Before vs. After MCB Establishment: The GMP Watershed

blocks.zh: MCB 建立前（研發早期克隆篩選）：可套用 GMP 原則（principles），不強制完整 GMP。但文件仍需完整，以支持後續追溯。
blocks.en: Before MCB establishment (early R&D clone selection): GMP principles may be applied and full GMP is not mandatory. Documentation must still be complete, to support later traceability.

blocks.zh: MCB 建立後：必須在完整 GMP 條件下操作——環境管制、文件、偏差管理一樣都不能少。
blocks.en: After MCB establishment: operations must be under full GMP conditions, with no relaxation of environmental control, documentation or deviation management.

blocks.zh: 這個分水嶺在 CDMO 承接新分子委託時非常重要——客戶轉移 MCB 時，需確認原建立條件是否符合要求。
blocks.en: This watershed is very important when a CDMO takes on a new molecule: when the client transfers an MCB, you need to confirm whether the original establishment conditions meet the requirements.

blocks.zh: 比喻：MCB 是「種源」，WCB 是「種苗」
blocks.en: Analogy: The MCB Is the "Seed Source", the WCB Is the "Seedlings"

blocks.zh: 農業比喻：MCB 是種源中心保管的珍貴原種，WCB 是農民每季從種源中心取出的種苗。每季都從種源補充種苗，確保農作物的遺傳穩定性，不會因為多代繁殖而退化。
blocks.en: An agricultural analogy: the MCB is the precious original stock kept by the seed centre, and the WCB is the seedlings a farmer collects from the centre each season. Replenishing seedlings from the source every season keeps the crop genetically stable, so it does not degrade through many generations of propagation.

blocks.zh: 生物製程中「代數限制」（passages limit）就是確保細胞不會隨著繁殖代數增加而產生不可控的基因漂移。
blocks.en: The passage limit in biological processes ensures that cells do not undergo uncontrolled genetic drift as the number of generations increases.

blocks.zh: 液態氮氣相儲存：為什麼是氣相而非液相？
blocks.en: Liquid Nitrogen Vapour Phase Storage: Why Vapour Rather Than Liquid?

blocks.zh: 傳統方法將樣品直接浸入液態氮（液相儲存），但這可能造成交叉汙染——若某個安瓿有細微裂縫，液態氮會滲入，取出復溫時可能洩出並汙染其他樣品。
blocks.en: The traditional method immerses samples directly in liquid nitrogen (liquid phase storage), but this can cause cross-contamination: if an ampoule has a tiny crack, liquid nitrogen seeps in, and on thawing it may leak out and contaminate other samples.

blocks.zh: 氣相儲存（vapour phase）讓樣品懸浮在氮氣蒸氣中而非直接接觸液氮，降低交叉汙染風險。溫度約 -150°C 至 -190°C，足以長期保存生物活性。
blocks.en: Vapour phase storage keeps samples suspended in nitrogen vapour rather than in direct contact with liquid nitrogen, reducing the risk of cross-contamination. The temperature is about -150°C to -190°C, which is sufficient for long-term preservation of biological activity.

blocks.zh: 備份分存（Split Stock）：災難防護的必要措施
blocks.en: Split Stock: An Essential Disaster Safeguard

blocks.zh: MCB 只有一份保存在同一地點，若發生火災、停電、液氮外洩，整條產品線就此消失。
blocks.en: If the MCB is kept in only one copy at one site, a fire, power failure or liquid nitrogen leak could wipe out the whole product line.

blocks.zh: Annex 2B 建議分存在不同地點——理想情況是不同城市甚至不同國家的合格儲存設施。對 CDMO 而言，這是風險管理的基本動作。
blocks.en: Annex 2B recommends storing in separate locations: ideally qualified storage facilities in different cities or even different countries. For a CDMO, this is a basic risk management action.

blocks.zh: MCB/WCB 管理查核要點
blocks.en: MCB/WCB Management: Audit Checkpoints

blocks.zh: 庫存清單是否持續更新（包含每次使用紀錄）
blocks.en: Is the inventory list continuously updated (including a record of every use)?

blocks.zh: 溫度監控是否連續且有警報設置
blocks.en: Is temperature monitoring continuous, with alarms set?

blocks.zh: 液氮液位是否定期監控
blocks.en: Is the liquid nitrogen level monitored regularly?

blocks.zh: 偏差（如停電事件）是否有完整調查和 CAPA
blocks.en: Are deviations (such as power outage events) fully investigated, with CAPA?

blocks.zh: 取出安瓿後是否有「不退還」政策的執行記錄
blocks.en: Are there records showing the "no return" policy for withdrawn ampoules is enforced?

blocks.zh: 備份分存設施的管制標準是否等同主庫
blocks.en: Are the control standards of the backup split-storage facility equivalent to those of the main facility?

blocks.zh: Part A — 操作原則與品質管制
blocks.en: Part A: Operating Principles and Quality Control

blocks.zh: 操作原則與品質管制解析
blocks.en: Operating Principles and Quality Control Explained

blocks.zh: 累積變更影響評估
blocks.en: Assessing the Impact of Cumulative Changes

blocks.zh: 生物製程的「累積效應」問題比化學製藥更顯著：單一變更（如更換培養基供應商）可能影響不大，但同期進行的多個微小變更疊加起來，可能對產品品質產生顯著影響。
blocks.en: The "cumulative effect" problem is more pronounced in biological processes than in chemical pharmaceutical manufacture: a single change (such as switching media suppliers) may have little effect, but several small changes made over the same period can add up to a significant impact on product quality.

blocks.zh: Annex 2B 要求在 PQR（產品品質審查）中定期評估累積變更——這不只是合規要求，也是維護生物製程穩定性的好工具。
blocks.en: Annex 2B requires cumulative changes to be evaluated periodically in the PQR (product quality review). This is not only a compliance requirement but also a good tool for maintaining the stability of the biological process.

blocks.zh: 發酵製程的連續監控
blocks.en: Continuous Monitoring of the Fermentation Process

blocks.zh: 不同於固體製劑批次，發酵過程是動態的——pH、溫度、溶氧、糖濃度等參數隨時間變化。連續監控這些參數並將數據納入批次紀錄，是追溯製程異常的重要手段。
blocks.en: Unlike a solid dosage form batch, fermentation is dynamic: parameters such as pH, temperature, dissolved oxygen and sugar concentration change over time. Monitoring these parameters continuously and including the data in the batch record is an important means of tracing process abnormalities.

blocks.zh: 現代的 Process Analytical Technology（PAT）和 SCADA 系統可自動記錄這些數據，大幅減少人工抄錄錯誤。
blocks.en: Modern Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and SCADA systems can record these data automatically, greatly reducing manual transcription errors.

blocks.zh: 比喻：病毒滅活的「兩室隔離」
blocks.en: Analogy: "Two-Room Segregation" for Virus Inactivation

blocks.zh: 就像急診室處置完傳染病患者後，需要徹底消毒才能接待下一位病患。病毒滅活步驟完成後，必須確保滅活後的產品不會接觸任何尚未處理的活性材料。
blocks.en: It is like an emergency room that must be thoroughly disinfected after treating an infectious patient before receiving the next one. After the virus inactivation step is complete, you must ensure the inactivated product never comes into contact with any not-yet-processed live material.

blocks.zh: 「轉移到第二個容器」的做法，就是物理隔離滅活前後的材料——產品接觸面的殘留活性病毒風險，靠空間隔離徹底消除。
blocks.en: "Transfer to a second container" is a physical separation of the material before and after inactivation: the risk of residual live virus on product contact surfaces is eliminated entirely by spatial separation.

blocks.zh: 短效期產品：兩階段放行（Two-Stage Release）
blocks.en: Short Shelf-Life Products: Two-Stage Release

blocks.zh: 某些生物製品（如細胞治療、放射性藥品）的保存期限只有數天，傳統的先完成所有測試再放行根本行不通。
blocks.en: Some biological products (such as cell therapies and radiopharmaceuticals) have a shelf life of only a few days, so the traditional approach of completing all tests before release is simply not workable.

blocks.zh: 解決方案：兩階段放行——
blocks.en: Solution: two-stage release -

blocks.zh: 第一階段（Responsible Person）：評估製程數據、環境監控結果，初步認可
blocks.en: Stage 1 (Responsible Person): evaluate process data and environmental monitoring results, and give initial approval

blocks.zh: 第二階段（Authorised Person）：最終測試完成後，補充完整放行
blocks.en: Stage 2 (Authorised Person): after the final tests are complete, give complete release

blocks.zh: 前提是整個製程必須有高度的參數理解和驗證，才能支撐「提前放行」的信心。
blocks.en: The precondition is a high level of process parameter understanding and validation across the whole process, to support confidence in "early release".

blocks.zh: 色層分析管柱：多產品廠的關鍵管制點
blocks.en: Chromatography Columns: A Key Control Point in Multi-Product Facilities

blocks.zh: 在多產品 CDMO 廠，蛋白質 A 管柱（Protein A column）用於多個 mAb 產品的純化是常見安排。需要管制的要素：
blocks.en: In a multi-product CDMO site, it is common to use the same Protein A column to purify several mAb products. The elements to control are:

blocks.zh: 每個管柱的使用壽命（循環次數）和再生方法
blocks.en: Service life of each column (number of cycles) and regeneration method

blocks.zh: 不同產品間的清潔驗證（是否允許跨產品使用？）
blocks.en: Cleaning validation between products (is cross-product use permitted?)

blocks.zh: 管柱效能衰退的接受標準（如板高、不對稱因子）
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria for column performance degradation (such as plate height and asymmetry factor)

blocks.zh: 廢棄管柱的處理程序
blocks.en: Disposal procedure for retired columns

blocks.zh: Annex 2B 明確不鼓勵在不同純化步驟間重複使用同一管柱——每個步驟應有專屬管柱。
blocks.en: Annex 2B explicitly discourages reusing the same column across different purification steps: each step should have its own dedicated column.

blocks.zh: 自體治療產品的標示要求
blocks.en: Labelling Requirements for Autologous Products

blocks.zh: 「For autologous use only（僅供自體使用）」不只是文字規定——這條標示是防止悲劇的最後防線。
blocks.en: "For autologous use only" is more than a wording requirement: this label is the last line of defence against a tragedy.

blocks.zh: 自體細胞治療中，患者 A 的細胞若誤用於患者 B，不僅無效，還可能引發免疫排斥。標示、標籤相容性（超低溫下不脫落）、雙人確認程序缺一不可。
blocks.en: In autologous cell therapy, if patient A's cells are mistakenly given to patient B, they are not only ineffective but may also cause immune rejection. Labelling, label compatibility (not detaching at ultra-low temperatures) and a two-person verification procedure are all indispensable.

blocks.zh: Part B — 動物源性產品與過敏原
blocks.en: Part B: Animal-Derived Products and Allergens

blocks.zh: 動物源性產品與過敏原解析
blocks.en: Animal-Derived Products and Allergens Explained

blocks.zh: 動物源性原料的「延伸供應鏈」管理
blocks.en: Managing the "Extended Supply Chain" of Animal-Derived Raw Materials

blocks.zh: 豬胰蛋白酶的供應鏈可能是：農場 → 屠宰場 → 初步處理商 → 冷鏈運輸 → 中間商 → 原料供應商 → CDMO。
blocks.en: The supply chain for porcine trypsin may be: farm → slaughterhouse → primary processor → cold chain transport → intermediary → raw material supplier → CDMO.

blocks.zh: 每個環節都可能引入品質風險。製程地圖（process map）需要詳細到可以追溯每一個環節的責任方，才能在問題發生時快速定位根因。
blocks.en: Every link can introduce a quality risk. The process map needs to be detailed enough to identify the responsible party at each link, so the root cause can be located quickly when a problem occurs.

blocks.zh: OIE 動物疾病監控的實務應用
blocks.en: Practical Use of OIE Animal Disease Surveillance

blocks.zh: OIE（世界動物衛生組織）定期發布各國動物疾病報告。台灣 CDMO 採購豬或牛源性原料時，需定期檢視供應國的 OIE 報告，評估口蹄疫、非洲豬瘟、BSE 等疫情對供應鏈的影響。
blocks.en: The OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health) regularly publishes animal disease reports by country. When a Taiwan CDMO buys porcine- or bovine-derived raw materials, it should regularly review the OIE reports of the supplying country and assess the impact of foot-and-mouth disease, African swine fever, BSE and other outbreaks on the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 若供應國爆發動物疫情，應觸發供應商審核和原料替代方案評估，而非等到原料測試失敗才行動。
blocks.en: If an animal disease outbreak occurs in the supplying country, it should trigger a supplier review and evaluation of alternative raw materials, rather than waiting until raw material testing fails.

blocks.zh: 比喻：過敏原每種萃取物 = 一種獨立活性成分
blocks.en: Analogy: Each Allergen Extract = A Separate Active Ingredient

blocks.zh: 一瓶過敏原免疫治療藥水可能含有塵蟎、貓毛、花粉等多種成分。Annex 2B 要求每種成分的萃取物分開製備和管制，最後才混合。
blocks.en: A bottle of allergen immunotherapy solution may contain dust mite, cat dander, pollen and other components. Annex 2B requires the extract of each component to be prepared and controlled separately, and mixed only at the end.

blocks.zh: 這就像調雞尾酒——每種酒都要分開品質管制，最後才依配方混合。若其中一種萃取物不合格，只需捨棄那種，不影響其他成分。
blocks.en: It is like mixing cocktails: each spirit is quality-controlled separately and blended only at the end according to the recipe. If one extract fails, only that one is discarded, without affecting the other components.

blocks.zh: 屠宰場稽核 — CDMO 的挑戰
blocks.en: Slaughterhouse Audits: A Challenge for the CDMO

blocks.zh: 屠宰場不受 GMP 監管，但 Annex 2B 要求其控制措施提供「同等水準」的保證。CDMO 稽核屠宰場時的評估重點：
blocks.en: Slaughterhouses are not regulated under GMP, but Annex 2B requires their control measures to provide an "equivalent level" of assurance. Points to assess when a CDMO audits a slaughterhouse:

blocks.zh: 動物衛生檢驗程序（獸醫師資格）
blocks.en: Animal health inspection procedures (qualifications of the veterinarian)

blocks.zh: 動物識別和追溯系統
blocks.en: Animal identification and traceability system

blocks.zh: 採集過程的衛生管制
blocks.en: Hygiene control during collection

blocks.zh: 冷鏈管理（從採集到出貨的溫度記錄）
blocks.en: Cold chain management (temperature records from collection to shipment)

blocks.zh: 異常動物的隔離和處理程序
blocks.en: Segregation and handling procedures for abnormal animals

blocks.zh: Part B — 免疫血清、疫苗與重組產品
blocks.en: Part B: Immune Sera, Vaccines and Recombinant Products

blocks.zh: 免疫血清、疫苗與重組產品解析
blocks.en: Immune Sera, Vaccines and Recombinant Products Explained

blocks.zh: 免疫血清製造：動物就是「反應器」
blocks.en: Immune Serum Manufacture: The Animal Is the "Bioreactor"

blocks.zh: 用馬製造抗毒血清的流程：將毒素（如蛇毒）注射入馬體 → 馬產生抗體 → 採集血液 → 純化抗體（可進一步製備 Fab 片段降低過敏風險）。
blocks.en: The process for making antitoxin serum from horses: inject a toxin (such as snake venom) into the horse → the horse produces antibodies → collect blood → purify the antibodies (Fab fragments can be prepared to reduce allergy risk).

blocks.zh: 免疫時間表和採血時間表必須按照 CTA/MA 核准的方案執行——過早採血抗體效價不夠，過晚可能影響動物健康。
blocks.en: The immunisation schedule and bleeding schedule must follow the protocol approved in the CTA/MA: bleeding too early gives insufficient antibody titre, and too late may affect the animal's health.

blocks.zh: 疫苗製造的關鍵隔離原則
blocks.en: Key Segregation Principle in Vaccine Manufacture

blocks.zh: 活病毒 vs. 滅活病毒的嚴格隔離：裝有滅活疫苗的容器，絕對不能在仍有活性病原體的區域開啟取樣。
blocks.en: Strict segregation of live vs. inactivated virus: a container holding inactivated vaccine must never be opened for sampling in an area where live pathogens are still present.

blocks.zh: 這一條看似基本，卻在現實操作中容易因為流程設計不當而出錯——例如，在病毒滅活後、換瓶分裝前，樣品需要在哪裡取樣？分析人員是否需要進入仍有活毒的區域？這些都需要在 SOP 中明確規定。
blocks.en: This seems basic, but in real operations it is easily violated through poor process design. For example, where is the sample taken after virus inactivation and before transfer to a new container? Do analysts have to enter an area that still contains live virus? All of this must be specified clearly in SOPs.

blocks.zh: 比喻：大流行疫苗菌株 = 特許危險品
blocks.en: Analogy: Pandemic Vaccine Strains = Licensed Hazardous Materials

blocks.zh: 製造 H5N1 禽流感疫苗時，廠商必須使用實際的高致病性病毒株。這就像為了研究核能安全而需要接觸放射性材料——需要特別許可、特殊設施和嚴格的安全程序。
blocks.en: To make an H5N1 avian influenza vaccine, the manufacturer must use the actual highly pathogenic virus strain. It is like needing to handle radioactive material to study nuclear safety: special permits, special facilities and strict safety procedures are required.

blocks.zh: 主管機關的批准文件必須在廠內隨時可供查驗，稽查員會核對設施的生物安全等級是否與使用的病毒株相符。
blocks.en: The regulator's approval documents must be available on site at all times for inspection, and inspectors will check that the facility's biosafety level matches the virus strain used.

blocks.zh: 重組蛋白純化：雜質去除的三個維度
blocks.en: Recombinant Protein Purification: Three Dimensions of Impurity Removal

blocks.zh: 製程相關雜質：宿主細胞蛋白（HCP）、宿主細胞 DNA、殘留培養基成分
blocks.en: Process-related impurities: host cell proteins (HCP), host cell DNA, residual media components

blocks.zh: 產品相關雜質：聚集體、片段、錯誤折疊的蛋白質
blocks.en: Product-related impurities: aggregates, fragments, misfolded proteins

blocks.zh: 病毒安全性：清除/滅活病毒的步驟需要驗證（如低 pH 滅活 + 奈米過濾）
blocks.en: Viral safety: virus removal/inactivation steps need to be validated (such as low pH inactivation + nanofiltration)

blocks.zh: 每個純化步驟都需要驗證其去除能力，並設定明確的接受標準。多次收穫（multiple harvests）需特別注意累積代數不超過規格限制。
blocks.en: Every purification step needs its removal capacity validated and clear acceptance criteria set. For multiple harvests, take particular care that the cumulative passage number does not exceed the specification limit.

blocks.zh: 重組蛋白 CDMO 的製程驗證重點
blocks.en: Process Validation Focus Points for a Recombinant Protein CDMO

blocks.zh: 承接 mAb 或重組疫苗委託，製程驗證需涵蓋：
blocks.en: When taking on an mAb or recombinant vaccine contract, process validation should cover:

blocks.zh: 細胞生長曲線和蛋白質表現量的批次一致性
blocks.en: Batch-to-batch consistency of the cell growth curve and protein expression level

blocks.zh: 各純化步驟的 HCP/DNA 去除率（對數清除值）
blocks.en: HCP/DNA clearance of each purification step (log reduction value)

blocks.zh: 病毒安全性驗證（spike study）
blocks.en: Viral safety validation (spiking study)

blocks.zh: 培養時間/代數的上限驗證
blocks.en: Validation of the upper limit for culture time/passage number

blocks.zh: 多次收穫的批次間一致性
blocks.en: Batch-to-batch consistency across multiple harvests

blocks.zh: Part B — 單株抗體、基因轉殖動物與植物
blocks.en: Part B: Monoclonal Antibodies, Transgenic Animals and Plants

blocks.zh: 單株抗體、基因轉殖動植物解析
blocks.en: Monoclonal Antibodies and Transgenic Animals and Plants Explained

blocks.zh: mAb 製造平台：病毒安全性的三重保護
blocks.en: mAb Manufacturing Platform: Three Layers of Protection for Viral Safety

blocks.zh: mAb 通常用中國倉鼠卵巢（CHO）細胞或融合瘤（hybridoma）細胞製造，這些細胞本身可能帶有內源性逆轉錄病毒（endogenous retroviruses）。
blocks.en: mAbs are usually produced in Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells or hybridoma cells, and these cells may themselves carry endogenous retroviruses.

blocks.zh: 三重防護策略：
blocks.en: Three-layer protection strategy:

blocks.zh: 原材料（培養基、血清）病毒測試
blocks.en: Virus testing of raw materials (media, serum)

blocks.zh: 製造過程的病毒去除步驟（低 pH、nanofiltration）
blocks.en: Virus removal steps in the manufacturing process (low pH, nanofiltration)

blocks.zh: 最終產品的病毒檢測
blocks.en: Virus testing of the final product

blocks.zh: 「同一技術平台的數據可接受」（B6.1）意味著若某企業的 CHO 平台已建立完整病毒清除數據，新產品可部分借用，縮短開發時間。
blocks.en: "Data from the same technology platform are acceptable" (B6.1) means that if a company's CHO platform already has complete virus clearance data, a new product can partly draw on it, shortening development time.

blocks.zh: 比喻：基因轉殖山羊是「活體工廠」
blocks.en: Analogy: A Transgenic Goat Is a "Living Factory"

blocks.zh: 想像一個表達人類凝血因子 IX 的基因轉殖山羊群——工廠的「生產設備」就是這些山羊，牠們的乳汁含有目標蛋白質。
blocks.en: Imagine a herd of transgenic goats expressing human coagulation factor IX: the factory's "production equipment" is the goats themselves, and their milk contains the target protein.

blocks.zh: 挑戰：山羊是活生生的動物，不像不鏽鋼發酵槽可以精確控制環境。每隻山羊的遺傳背景（genealogy）必須從創始動物完整記錄，確保所有生產動物都來自同一轉殖株，不同轉殖株的乳汁不能混合。
blocks.en: The challenge: goats are living animals, and unlike a stainless steel fermenter their environment cannot be controlled precisely. The genealogy of each goat must be fully documented from the founder animal, to ensure that all production animals derive from the same transgenic line, and milk from different transgenic lines must not be mixed.

blocks.zh: 基因轉殖植物製藥：開放田地的獨特挑戰
blocks.en: Transgenic Plant Pharming: The Unique Challenges of Open Fields

blocks.zh: 在開放田地種植基因轉殖產藥作物，面臨的風險包括：
blocks.en: Risks of growing transgenic pharmaceutical crops in open fields include:

blocks.zh: 花粉飄散造成基因汙染鄰近農田
blocks.en: Pollen drift causing genetic contamination of neighbouring fields

blocks.zh: 農藥/肥料殘留
blocks.en: Pesticide/fertiliser residues

blocks.zh: 天候影響（乾旱、颱風）導致批次間一致性差
blocks.en: Weather effects (drought, typhoons) causing poor batch-to-batch consistency

blocks.zh: 害蟲和微生物汙染
blocks.en: Pest and microbial contamination

blocks.zh: 這些是 Annex 2B 要求必須監控和記錄的環境條件，同時參考 GACP（良好農業採集規範）指引。
blocks.en: These are environmental conditions that Annex 2B requires to be monitored and recorded, with reference also to the GACP (Good Agricultural and Collection Practice) guidance.

blocks.zh: ADC（抗體藥物結合物）的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special Considerations for ADCs (Antibody-Drug Conjugates)

blocks.zh: B6.3 提到的「進一步修飾」（conjugation、chemical linking）正是 ADC 的製造步驟：將細胞毒性小分子連接到 mAb 上。
blocks.en: The "further modification" mentioned in B6.3 (conjugation, chemical linking) is precisely the manufacturing step of an ADC: linking a cytotoxic small molecule to an mAb.

blocks.zh: 這個步驟涉及高毒性化合物的操作，需要同時符合：mAb GMP（Annex 2B）+ 高毒性化合物操作安全（工業安全規定）+ 結合物驗證（連接比例、均一性）。台灣 CDMO 發展 ADC 能力時，需規劃整合性的廠房和 SOP 架構。
blocks.en: This step involves handling highly toxic compounds and must satisfy all of the following: mAb GMP (Annex 2B) + safe handling of highly toxic compounds (industrial safety regulations) + conjugate validation (linking ratio, homogeneity). When a Taiwan CDMO develops ADC capability, it needs to plan an integrated facility and SOP architecture.

blocks.zh: mAb 生產週期終止的決策標準
blocks.en: Decision Criteria for Ending an mAb Production Cycle

blocks.zh: B6.2 提到「生產週期終止標準」——CDMO 應在與客戶的技術協議中明確定義：
blocks.en: B6.2 mentions "criteria for ending a production cycle". The CDMO should define these clearly in the technical agreement with the client:

blocks.zh: 活細胞密度（VCD）下降到何值時終止
blocks.en: The viable cell density (VCD) value at which to terminate

blocks.zh: 細胞活力（Viability）低於多少時終止
blocks.en: The cell viability below which to terminate

blocks.zh: 代謝副產品（乳酸、氨）超過何濃度時終止
blocks.en: The concentration of metabolic by-products (lactate, ammonia) above which to terminate

blocks.zh: 發現微生物汙染時的立即終止程序
blocks.en: Immediate termination procedure when microbial contamination is found

blocks.zh: 提前終止批次的文件和客戶通知要求
blocks.en: Documentation and client notification requirements for early termination of a batch

blocks.zh: 本節學習重點回顧
blocks.en: Review of Key Learning Points in This Section

blocks.zh: 範圍判斷：Annex 2B 涵蓋所有非 ATMP 生物製品；Table 1 的七大產品類型幫助你定位在哪個製造步驟需要完整 GMP vs. 僅套用 GMP 原則——滅菌前以 Part II 為主，滅菌後適用 Part I。
blocks.en: Scope determination: Annex 2B covers all non-ATMP biological products; the seven product types in Table 1 help you locate at which manufacturing step full GMP is needed vs. only GMP principles - before sterilisation mainly Part II, after sterilisation Part I applies.

blocks.zh: MCB/WCB 雙層系統：MCB 在完整 GMP 下建立，是產品生命週期的生物起點；代數限制需符合 CTA/MA；備份分存在不同地點是災難防護的基本措施；取出的安瓿不得退還。
blocks.en: MCB/WCB two-tier system: the MCB is established under full GMP and is the biological starting point of the product lifecycle; passage limits must comply with the CTA/MA; split storage in separate locations is a basic disaster safeguard; ampoules withdrawn must not be returned.

blocks.zh: 製造操作核心：連續監控發酵數據入批次紀錄；病毒滅活前後嚴格隔離；色層分析管柱需有使用壽命和接受標準；短效期產品需兩階段放行策略。
blocks.en: Core manufacturing operations: continuous monitoring of fermentation data into batch records; strict segregation before and after virus inactivation; chromatography columns need service life and acceptance criteria; short shelf-life products need a two-stage release strategy.

blocks.zh: Part B 特定產品：疫苗的活毒/滅活毒嚴格分區；mAb 需強調病毒安全性平台數據；基因轉殖動植物面臨批次間一致性挑戰，需完整世代追溯；ADC 修飾步驟需整合毒性安全管制。
blocks.en: Part B specific products: strict zoning of live and inactivated virus for vaccines; mAbs need emphasis on platform viral safety data; transgenic animals and plants face batch-to-batch consistency challenges and need complete generational traceability; ADC modification steps need integrated toxicity and safety control.
